title: ChatQuery loads all chat IDs into memory for Rust-side pagination
description: ChatQueryHandler (chat.rs lines 491-502) calls list_ids() which returns all chat IDs, then performs skip/take in Rust. For a user with many chats this allocates and transfers the full ID list from SQLite to Rust even when the caller only wants one page. The store's list_ids() should accept optional LIMIT/OFFSET parameters (or separate paginated and full-list variants), pushing pagination into SQL. This is low priority for Phase 1 (single user, few chats) but becomes a real cost at scale.
